notes.title: Hyper Flux Demo is out in the Steam Next Fest Oct 2024!
notes.content:
[h2]Hyper Flux Demo is released to the public to try. [/h2]
For those who haven't had time due to their busy weekday schedules, this is a reminder to try the demo this weekend! Also a big thanks to those who has tried the game already! 


Regardless of whether you end up liking the game or not, this Next Fest demo already counts as a success to me due to this being [b]my first game[/b].

[h3]NOTE[/h3]
A bunch of the issues which were present in the game earlier have been fixed, like [b]horizontal mouse sensitivity not working[/b], along with the pesky bug of the [b]player passing through objects[/b], if you faced any of those issues and stopped, feel free to play again!



Other than that, the demo will probably enter freeze and won't have any updates anymore (unless there's game-breaking issues).
The demo will remain active even in the future as it allows for ample opportunity for people to try the game in it's full glory! Although I'm still confused if I should keep the leaderboards active..


If you have any feedback for the game or any issues you find, feel free to reach out!
